theorems.statement: ∀ (n N p : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn p) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (u : Rn n), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ψ u ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ u → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u → ∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w)
